# MarginMix

> MarginMix is a decision support system for agency and consulting leaders to pressure test engagement pricing, staffing, scope, billing, and delivery assumptions before work begins.

MarginMix focuses on margin governance. It is not a delivery or productivity platform.

## Product information

- Available now: the free Engagement Leak Calculator estimates indicative delivery and scope exposure from user supplied assumptions. Its output is a planning estimate based on preset rules, not an audited loss.
- Calculator inputs and results remain in the browser and are not saved to MarginMix’s database.
- The agency audit questionnaire collects structured answers and emails a PDF of the responses. It asks users to reference documents; document uploads are not currently available.
- Planned: a deterministic risk assessment based on the statement of work (SOW), timesheet data and other proprietary engagement information. Document upload and analysis are not available yet; registering interest does not start an assessment.
- Margin Intelligence is a future direction, not a live capability.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://marginmix.ai/): MarginMix overview and sample calculator snapshot.
- [Platform](https://marginmix.ai/platform): Current, planned, and future product capabilities.
- [Why choose MarginMix](https://marginmix.ai/why-choose): The decision support approach and its intended use.
- [Founder](https://marginmix.ai/founder): The perspective behind MarginMix.
- [Free Engagement Leak Calculator](https://marginmix.ai/free-tier/input): Interactive estimate for one engagement.
- [Quick Risk Check](https://marginmix.ai/quick-profiler): Short interactive engagement risk check.
- [Agency audit questionnaire](https://marginmix.ai/audit-questions): Structured questionnaire for agency engagement assumptions.

Interactive calculators, questionnaires, and assessment results depend on user input and are not static reference pages.
